doc.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Later career, remasters and other interests
title: Freddie Hubbard and Curtis Fuller on getting their sound
summary: Don relays that musicians say Rudy got their sound, and Rudy calls this his reward.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: But the musicians, you know, I’ve been involved with so many of the musicians and they always love the fact that you were really conscious of them, and trying to get their sound. That’s something that is a common thing, you know, that you weren’t just getting the quote unquote trumpet sound. Freddie Hubbard told me that, “Rudy just always got my sound.” That’s always what you were looking for.
That was the goal and that’s my reward. When you tell me stories like that from the musicians I respect, and when he says things like that, that’s my reward.
Just the night before last I was talking to Curtis Fuller, you know, “That’s my sound, that’s the sound that Rudy gets.”
I try to understand them. I think I do. I grew up with them. Without them there would be nothing to talk about. I’d be a photographer taking baby pictures. (Laughs)
I don’t think you would ever be!
